title: Koszul augmentation is an isomorphism on principal-open union
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, f : Fin r → A, and e ≥ 1. Write X = Spec A [def-pc-scheme], I for the deleted, shifted Koszul complex on the powers f(i)^e [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex, def-pc-shifted-koszul-augmentation]. The canonical augmentation I → A [def-pc-shifted-koszul-augmentation], after termwise associated sheaves and derived localization, restricts to an isomorphism on U = ⋃ᵢ D(f(i)).

source.place: Tag 08CX (perfect-section-koszul), definition of $I^\bullet$ and the assertion that $I_e\to\mathcal O_X$ becomes an isomorphism on $U$

proof.text: Write e=d+1 using e>=1. The extended koszulOpenAugmentation on exponent d+1 agrees definitionally with shiftedKoszulAugmentation on these powers. Apply the existing cone comparison to identify its mapping cone with the full extended Koszul complex. Associated sheaves commute with mapping cones (Mathlib mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso), and derived localization and exact open restriction transport this isomorphism.

The scheme basic opens of the global sections corresponding to f_i are PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen(f_i), by basicOpen_eq_of_affine. Positive powers have the same basic opens by PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_pow. Therefore the union U is also the basic-open union of the powered family. Apply isZero_restrict_koszul_base to that family: the derived restriction of the sheafified full Koszul complex is zero. This theorem includes r=0 and the zero ring.

The mapping-cone triangle of the sheafified augmentation is distinguished in the derived category. Exact derived open restriction preserves distinguished triangles. Transport the preceding zero-object result along the cone comparison to show the third object of this restricted triangle is zero. Mathlib Triangle.isZero₃_iff_isIso₁ then says its first morphism, exactly the restricted affineKoszulAugmentation, is an isomorphism.

theorem affine_perfect_koszul_principal_unit_iso
    (A : Type a) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A) (e : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{b}
      (SheafOfModules.{a} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{b}
        (SheafOfModules.{a} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over U))] :
    IsIso (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)
        (⨆ i : Fin r, (Spec (.of A)).basicOpen
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv (f i)))).mapDerivedCategory).map
            (affineKoszulAugmentation A r (fun i ↦ f i ^ e)))
